Solution: 72|72 inches -> 1 foot = 12 inches, 1 yard = 3 feet. So 2 yards = 6 feet = 6 x 12 = 72 inches

Question Choices: How many milliliters are in 2.5 liters?
Solution: 2500|2500 milliliters -> 1 liter = 1000 milliliters, so 2.5 liters = 2.5 x 1000 = 2500 milliliters
